**Timeline:** The capture spans 483 seconds of network activity from a Windows 11 Pro enterprise workstation. STRRAT was already resident and actively beaconing to its C2 server throughout the captured period.

**Key Findings:**

The infected workstation (DESKTOP-SKBR25F) continuously sends system information to 141.98.10.79:12132 on an unencrypted TCP connection. Every ~5 seconds, it transmits a beacon packet with the structure:

`ping|STRRAT|1BE8292C|DESKTOP-SKBR25F|ccollier|Microsoft Windows 11 Pro|64-bit|Windows Defender||1.6|US:United States|Not Installed|[uptime_seconds]`

Windows Defender is reported as "Not Installed" (despite the OS having it), a known STRRAT stealth technique.

All other external traffic (to Microsoft services, GitHub, Maven Central, Oracle Java downloads, and Bing) appears benign and consistent with normal Windows enterprise operation. No malware payload files, no lateral movement, and no exfiltration activity detected in this capture segment.
